questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even in it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

 
• All wood are chairs.
 
• All chairs are blue.
 
• No chair is table.

**Conclusion:**

 
• Some tables are blue.
 
• No wood is a table.
 
• Some blue are wood.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows.
All conclusions, I, II and III, follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/293ccfe5343e05757f24b54c9f8f7800d31d396c92752879a0e7d91d29644bbe.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some tables are blue → False (There are no direct relation given. Hence, false)

II. No wood is a table → True (All wood are chair and No chair are table. So, no wood is a table is also true)

III. Some blue are wood → True (All wood are chair and all chair are Blue. So some blue are wood is true)

Thus, Both conclusion II and III follows.
